create_per_image_evaluation: create a PerImageEvaluation instance with num_groundtruth_classes and matching_iou_threshold for single-image object detection evaluation
test_compute_object_detection_metrics: test compute_object_detection_metrics to label detections as true positives or false positives per class
review_compute_tp_fp_for_single_class: review _compute_tp_fp_for_single_class to evaluate detections against ground truth boxes using IOU threshold matching
summarize_remove_invalid_boxes: summarize _remove_invalid_boxes to filter out detections with invalid box coordinates where xmax < xmin or ymax < ymin
